metadata.title: Popular Recipes Dataset
metadata.description: A curated collection of the most popular recipes from various cuisines worldwide

recipes.name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
While pasta cooks, cut guanciale into small cubes and cook in a large pan over medium heat until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks, whole eggs, grated cheeses, and black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Remove pan from heat, add hot pasta to the guanciale.
Quickly add the egg mixture, tossing constantly. Add pasta water as needed for creamy consistency.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, cumin, paprika, turmeric, and salt for at least 1 hour.
Thread chicken onto skewers and grill or broil until charred and cooked through.
In a large pan, melt butter and sauté onion until golden. Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and remaining garam masala. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and add the grilled chicken pieces.
Simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning with 1/4 cup water. Simmer until thickened.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or microwave.
Assemble tacos with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, onion, and cilantro.
Top with sour cream and salsa. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes until pliable. Drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Cook protein until done, set aside.
Add more oil, scramble eggs, then add garlic and tofu.
Add noodles and sauce, toss until noodles are coated and softened.
Add bean sprouts, half the green onions, and cooked protein.
Serve topped with peanuts, remaining green onions, and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, water, salt, and olive oil. Knead until smooth and elastic.
Let dough rise for 1-2 hours until doubled in size.
Preheat oven to highest setting (ideally 500°F/260°C) with pizza stone if available.
Blend tomatoes with garlic and a pinch of salt for sauce.
Divide dough into 2 portions. Stretch each into a thin round.
Spread thin layer of sauce, add mozzarella slices.
Bake for 10-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Top with fresh basil and drizzle of olive oil before serving.

recipes.name: Japanese Chicken Katsu Curry
instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, then coat with panko.
Sauté onion until soft, add carrots and potatoes with stock. Simmer 15 minutes.
Turn off heat, add curry roux blocks, stir until dissolved. Simmer until thickened.
Deep fry chicken at 350°F/175°C until golden and cooked through (6-8 minutes).
Slice katsu and serve over rice with curry sauce.

recipes.name: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Salt eggplant slices and let drain for 30 minutes. Pat dry and brush with oil.
Grill or bake eggplant and potato slices until tender.
Brown meat with onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, wine, cinnamon. Simmer 20 minutes.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk. Cook until thick.
Off heat, whisk in egg yolks, nutmeg, and half the cheese.
Layer in baking dish: potatoes, eggplant, meat sauce, more eggplant, béchamel.
Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350°F/180°C for 45 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Classic French Onion Soup
instructions: Melt butter with oil in a large pot. Add onions and cook over medium-low heat.
Stir occasionally for 45-60 minutes until deeply caramelized and golden brown.
Add wine and scrape up any browned bits. Cook until wine evaporates.
Add broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Simmer for 20 minutes. Season to taste.
Toast baguette slices under broiler until golden.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. Top with bread and generous cheese.
Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Marinate beef in soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic for 15 minutes.
Blanch spinach and bean sprouts separately. Season each with sesame oil and salt.
Sauté carrots, zucchini, and mushrooms separately until just tender.
Cook marinated beef in a hot pan until done.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Arrange rice in bowls, top with vegetables and beef in sections.
Place egg on top, serve with gochujang. Mix everything together before eating.

recipes.name: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Cook bacon in Dutch oven until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Pat beef dry, season, and brown in batches in bacon fat. Set aside.
Sauté carrots and onions until lightly browned.
Add garlic and tomato paste, cook 1 minute.
Return beef and bacon, add wine, broth, and herbs. Bring to simmer.
Cover and cook in 325°F/165°C oven for 2.5-3 hours until beef is tender.
Sauté mushrooms in butter, add to stew.
Make beurre manié with softened butter and flour, stir into stew to thicken.
Serve over mashed potatoes or with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, half the spices for 1 hour or overnight.
Grill or broil chicken until charred. Set aside.
Melt butter, sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 minutes.
Add remaining spices, cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato puree, simmer 15 minutes.
Blend sauce until smooth, return to pan.
Add cream, honey, and fenugreek. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add grilled chicken, simmer 10 minutes. Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet. Sauté onion and pepper until softened.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add spices, stir until fragrant.
Pour in tomatoes, season with salt. Simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make 6 wells in the sauce, crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are runny.
Top with feta and parsley. Serve from the pan with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Classic American Cheeseburger
instructions: Divide beef into 4 portions. Form into patties slightly larger than buns.
Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Grill or pan-fry over high heat, 3-4 minutes per side for medium.
Add cheese in last minute of cooking, cover to melt.
Toast buns on the grill or in a pan.
Spread mayo on bottom bun, add lettuce and tomato.
Place patty on top, add onion, pickles, ketchup, and mustard.
Top with bun and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Sushi (Salmon Nigiri and Rolls)
instructions: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Cook with 2.5 cups water.
Mix vinegar, sugar, and salt. Fold into hot rice, let cool to room temperature.
For nigiri: slice salmon into thin pieces. Wet hands, form small rice ovals.
Dab wasabi on rice, drape salmon over top. Press gently to adhere.
For rolls: place nori on bamboo mat, spread thin layer of rice.
Add cucumber and avocado in a line. Roll tightly using the mat.
Slice roll into 6-8 pieces with wet knife.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F/220°C.
Mix breadcrumbs with grated Parmesan. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, coat with breadcrumb mixture.
Heat oil in oven-safe skillet. Fry chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Top each piece with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 15-20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh basil. Serve over spaghetti if desired.

recipes.name: Pho (Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup)
instructions: Char onions and ginger over open flame or under broiler until blackened.
Blanch bones in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and rinse.
Add bones to large pot with 5 liters water. Bring to boil, then simmer.
Add charred onion, ginger, brisket, and spices in cheesecloth.
Simmer 3-4 hours, skimming foam regularly.
Remove brisket when tender (about 2 hours), slice thin.
Strain broth, season with fish sauce and sugar.
Cook rice noodles according to package. Divide among bowls.
Top with sliced brisket and raw beef.
Ladle hot broth over (it will cook the raw beef).
Serve with bean sprouts, basil, lime, jalapeño, hoisin, and sriracha.

recipes.name: Classic Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and sausage with onion. Add garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, and seasonings.
Simmer meat sauce 30 minutes.
Cook lasagna noodles according to package, drain.
Mix ricotta, 1 egg, half the mozzarella, half the Parmesan, and basil.
Spread thin layer of meat sauce in 9x13 baking dish.
Layer: noodles, ricotta mixture, meat sauce. Repeat 3 times.
Top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil, bake at 375°F/190°C for 45 minutes.
Remove foil, bake 15 more minutes until bubbly. Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F/190°C.
Cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add to butter mixture.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 9-12 minutes until golden brown but still soft.
Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.

recipes.name: Ramen (Tonkotsu)
instructions: Blanch pork bones 15 minutes, scrub clean, rinse.
Cover bones with fresh water, boil vigorously for 12+ hours, adding water as needed.
Broth should become creamy white and thick. Strain.
Make chashu: roll pork belly, braise in soy, mirin, sake, and water for 2-3 hours.
Marinate soft-boiled eggs in chashu liquid for at least 4 hours.
Cook ramen noodles according to package (usually 2-3 minutes).
Divide broth among bowls, add 2 tbsp chashu braising liquid to each.
Add noodles, sliced chashu, halved egg, green onions, nori.
Drizzle with mayu and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Guacamole
instructions: Cut avocados in half, remove pit, scoop flesh into bowl.
Add lime juice and salt, mash to desired consistency.
Fold in onion, jalapeño, cilantro, tomato, and garlic.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or as a condiment.

recipes.name: Falafel
instructions: Drain soaked chickpeas well. Do not use canned.
Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, and herbs in food processor until finely ground but not paste.
Add spices, baking powder, and salt. Refrigerate 1 hour.
Form mixture into small patties or balls.
Heat oil to 350°F/175°C. Fry falafel 3-4 minutes until deep golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve in pita with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Paella
instructions: Steep saffron in warm broth for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in paella pan or wide skillet. Brown chicken pieces, set aside.
Cook chorizo until fat renders. Add onion and cook until soft.
Add garlic, grated tomato, and paprika. Cook 5 minutes.
Add rice, stir to coat with sofrito. Add saffron broth.
Arrange chicken, green beans in the rice. Do not stir from this point.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add shrimp and mussels pressing into rice.
Cook 10 more minutes until rice is done and liquid absorbed.
Let develop socarrat (crispy bottom) for last 2-3 minutes on high heat.
Rest 5 minutes, serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk egg yolks and sugar until thick and pale (ribbon stage).
Add mascarpone and whisk until smooth.
In separate bowl, whip cream to stiff peaks. Fold into mascarpone mixture.
Mix espresso with liqueur if using.
Quickly dip ladyfingers in coffee (don't soak). Layer in 9x9 dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over ladyfingers.
Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and remaining cream.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Dust generously with cocoa powder before serving. Add chocolate shavings if desired.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
instructions: Scoop thick cream from top of coconut milk into a wok. Heat until oil separates.
Add curry paste, fry 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chicken, cook until no longer pink on outside.
Add remaining coconut milk and broth. Bring to simmer.
Add eggplant and bamboo shoots. Cook 10 minutes.
Add bell pepper, fish sauce, sugar, and lime leaves.
Simmer 5 more minutes. Stir in Thai basil.
Serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork BBQ
instructions: Mix all dry spices to make rub. Apply generously all over pork shoulder.
Let sit overnight in refrigerator if possible.
Smoke at 225°F/110°C for 8-10 hours until internal temp reaches 195°F/90°C.
(Alternative: Slow cooker on low 10-12 hours with vinegar and 1/2 cup water)
Let rest 30 minutes, then pull meat apart with forks, discarding fat.
Toss with apple cider vinegar and BBQ sauce to taste.
Serve on buns with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Toss bread cubes with olive oil, salt. Bake at 375°F/190°C until golden.
In large bowl, mash garlic and anchovies into a paste.
Whisk in egg yolks, lemon juice, mustard, and Worcestershire.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking to emulsify.
Stir in half the Parmesan. Season with pepper.
Toss lettuce with dressing, add croutons.
Top with remaining Parmesan and more pepper.

recipes.name: Dumplings (Jiaozi)
instructions: Mix flour with hot water, then add cold water. Knead until smooth. Rest 30 minutes.
Salt cabbage, let sit 10 minutes, squeeze out moisture.
Mix pork with cabbage, green onions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, wine, and pepper.
Divide dough into 30-36 pieces. Roll each into thin circle.
Place 1 tbsp filling in center. Fold and pleat edges to seal.
To boil: Cook in boiling water until they float, then 2 more minutes.
To pan-fry (potstickers): Fry bottoms until golden, add water, cover and steam until cooked.
Serve with soy sauce and rice vinegar dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Season chicken with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken in 1 tbsp butter until done. Slice and set aside.
Cook fettuccine according to package. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
In same pan, melt remaining butter. Sauté garlic 30 seconds.
Add cream, bring to simmer. Cook 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat, stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth.
Toss pasta with sauce, adding pasta water if needed.
Top with sliced chicken and parsley.

recipes.name: Hummus
instructions: Blend tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until light and creamy.
Add garlic, cumin, and salt. Blend until combined.
Add chickpeas and 2 tbsp olive oil. Blend until smooth.
With processor running, add reserved chickpea liquid until desired consistency.
Transfer to serving bowl, make swirls with back of spoon.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with paprika and parsley.

recipes.name: Fried Rice

ingredients.item: cooked shrimp, chicken, or char siu

instructions: Heat wok over high heat. Add 1 tbsp oil.
Scramble eggs until just set, break into pieces. Remove.
Add remaining oil. Stir-fry garlic and white parts of green onion.
Add vegetables and protein if using. Cook 2 minutes.
Add rice, breaking up clumps. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Push rice to side, add soy sauce to empty spot, let it sizzle.
Toss everything together with eggs, sesame oil, and pepper.
Garnish with green onion tops.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F/175°C. Grease a 9x5 loaf pan.
Mash bananas in a large bowl.
Mix in melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Add baking soda, salt, and cinnamon. Stir to combine.
Fold in flour until just combined. Add walnuts if using.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 55-65 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 minutes, then remove to wire rack.

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Cut potatoes into thick chips. Soak in cold water 30 minutes, drain and dry thoroughly.
First fry chips at 325°F/160°C for 5-6 minutes until cooked but not brown. Drain.
Make batter: whisk 1 cup flour, baking powder, and beer until smooth.
Season fish, dredge in remaining flour, then dip in batter.
Fry fish at 375°F/190°C for 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Second fry chips at 375°F/190°C for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels, season with salt immediately.
Serve with malt vinegar and tartar sauce.

recipes.name: Chimichurri Steak
instructions: Make chimichurri: combine parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, oil, and red pepper flakes.
Season with salt and pepper. Let sit at least 15 minutes for flavors to meld.
Season steaks generously with salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-sear over high heat: 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest steaks 5 minutes.
Spoon chimichurri generously over steaks before serving.

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Melt butter in large pot. Whisk in flour, cook 1 minute.
Gradually add milk, whisking constantly. Cook until thickened.
Remove from heat. Stir in cheeses, mustard, and cayenne until melted.
Season with salt and pepper. Fold in cooked macaroni.
For baked version: transfer to baking dish, top with breadcrumbs and butter.
Bake at 375°F/190°C for 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.name: New York Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F/160°C. Wrap outside of 9-inch springform pan with foil.
Mix graham crumbs with butter. Press into bottom and 1 inch up sides of pan.
Bake crust 10 minutes. Let cool.
Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Mix in sour cream, vanilla, lemon zest, and salt.
Add eggs and yolks one at a time, mixing just until combined after each.
Pour into crust. Place in larger pan filled with 1 inch hot water.
Bake 1 hour 15 minutes until set but center jiggles slightly.
Turn off oven, crack door, let cheesecake cool 1 hour in oven.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight before serving.
